title: PEB Milking Parlour Shed for Dravton Dairy | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Steel Mind Engineers built a 21,686 sq ft PEB milking parlour shed for Dravton Dairy at Chunian. A 17 ft high steel shed made for daily dairy work.
h1: PEB Milking Parlour Shed for Dravton Dairy at Chunian: 21,686 Square Feet Under One Roof
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a pre-engineered milking parlour shed for Dravton Dairy at Chunian. The shed is 17 feet high and covers 21,686 square feet.
alt: PEB milking parlour shed built by Steel Mind Engineers for Dravton Dairy at Chunian.

faq.q: What is a milking parlour shed?
faq.a: It is the covered building where cows are milked. It needs shade, clear floor space and steady airflow.

faq.q: Has Steel Mind Engineers built other structures for Dravton Dairy?
faq.a: Yes. It also built a dairy shed, a feed storage shed and a rapid exit structure at Chunian.

blocks.text: The milking parlour is where a dairy farm works every day, so it needs a roof that gives shade, a clear floor and good air. Steel Mind Engineers designed this shed as a pre-engineered building and made the steel in its Lahore factory.

A parlour needs wide clear space for animal movement and for the milking equipment. A 17-foot height supports airflow. The frames can carry hanging equipment where the layout needs it, and the roof can be insulated or ventilated as the farm requires.
This is one of four structures Steel Mind Engineers has built for Dravton Dairy at Chunian. The farm grew step by step, and steel framing made each step easy to add.
